issue.notes: The indicia of this issue is actually the indicia for X-Men: Legacy (2008 series) #209, giving that title, issue number and the corresponding May 2008 cover date. The correct cover date for this issue is June 2008 (it shipped a month later than X-Men: Legacy #209). Cover features the "Divided We Stand" logo.
